prose.def: An adverb meaning 'always,' either as unceasing continuity or readiness on every occasion, depending on context.
prose.article: ἀεί is a small adverb meaning "always" or "ever," and the Majority Standard Bible renders it "always" in every one of its 6 translated occurrences in the Byzantine New Testament (BSB agrees 100%). prose.def: Without God—describing Gentiles as separated from the true God, lacking knowledge of him, and in that sense godless.
